target: com.m3.collections.M3TreeMap<Integer,Integer>; typed public APIs only; no implementation inspection/reflection fallback

matrix.runtimeIdentityStatus: PENDING root full source/class/classpath hashes and public-API/correctness qualification. Labels are not sufficient pins.

data.traversal: int[] order prepared once; ascending/reverse or seeded Fisher-Yates using java.util.Random(0x4d33545245454cL ^ size)
data.boxing: No Integer.valueOf/new Integer/key generation in benchmark loops; map internal allocation remains measured.

workloads.entrySetFullScan: Prebuilt map from configured insertion order; iterate complete public entrySet; return 64-bit checksum of key/value pairs. Iterator/Entry projections and allocation are part of measurement.
workloads.freshInsertion: Create new map and put every reused key/value in configured order; Blackhole consumes finished map and final size is returned. Includes construction, growth and all puts.
workloads.removeReinsertChurn: Prebuilt map; for each configured key, remove then reinsert the returned same Integer value before the next key; return checksum of removed mappings. Every invocation restores logical contents; physical steady state may evolve during warmup.

harness.jdk: Java21; root pins exact same vendor/build/flags across runtime versions
harness.operationsPerInvocation: Absent; dynamic size is not misrepresented by a constant annotation
harness.jvmAnnotations: No jvmArgs/jvmArgsAppend overrides in @Fork or other annotations

validation: Trial setup validates key count, ascending entry traversal, all public lookups, checksum and a separate one-pass churn probe; trial teardown revalidates retained map. No validation/fixture construction in timed loops. This sanity check does not replace root correctness proofs.

normalization.primary: Keep raw JMH ns/op as whole invocation, score/error/confidence and all per-fork data.
normalization.insert: ns/put = rawScore/size; includes fresh constructor/growth overhead
normalization.churn: ns/(remove+reinsert pair)=rawScore/size; optional ns/mapMutation=rawScore/(2*size), explicitly labeled
normalization.errors: Apply same scale factor to score error/confidence endpoints; retain raw B/op and normalized B/entry/pair.

comparison: One source hash, one common processor/JMH configuration, and identical parameter cells across all qualified runtimes. Compile once against qualified common public API if binary compatible; pin generated benchmark classes/resources and exact runtime classpath separately. Never include two versions of M3 classes in one fork. Root records version execution order/background load and measures versions without competing benchmark jobs.
acceptance: Root correctness qualification and JMH generated benchmark discovery must pass before performance comparison. Any benchmark exception, timeout, incomplete cell, changed settings/source, missing gc profiler or identity mismatch invalidates that comparison. Report per-cell changes/regressions and uncertainty; do not infer universal peak, platform acceptance, or optimality from LeetCode/HackerRank problem statements.
storage: Author outputs <=16384B here. Root generated classes/resources/logs/results separately <=524288B. Every JVM/child uses verified S temp/user/cache routing, 128MiB heap and ActiveProcessorCount=2 supplied externally; recheck reserve/capacity. No annotation overrides of JVM resource flags.
sourceScope: Original task-specific benchmark only; no third-party benchmark, LeetCode or HackerRank code copied. JMH binaries/processor are reused unmodified from provisioned cache. Prior frozen contracts untouched.
